description.value: Purgatory Lookout is a scenic viewpoint in the Bella Coola backcountry reachable via the West Nusatsum FSR, offering views of the Noeick River valley, Styx Mountain, and Purgatory Glacier. The 7.8 km route from Odegaard Falls is open to foot, bike, and motorized travel, and is described as an ideal mountain bike excursion through meadows, ponds, and talus slopes. The Noeick River valley below was repeatedly scoured by jökulhlaups — glacial outburst floods from Ape Lake — giving the landscape its dramatic character.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM website tag points to bellacoolaforest.com but the fetched content was served from bellacoolatrails.ca (Bella Coola Trails Alliance), indicating a redirect or domain change — flagged as a concern. The trails alliance page for Purgatory Lookout explicitly lists 'Outhouse' among the site amenities, confirming washrooms. The listing also mentions 'Parking' (vehicle parking implied by 4x4 drive-to-lookout context) and describes the route as suitable for biking, but no bike-specific parking infrastructure is mentioned.
concerns: OSM website URL (bellacoolaforest.com/purgatory-lookout-and-noeick-river-forest-road/) served content from a different domain (bellacoolatrails.ca) — the OSM tag may be stale or the site redirects; contact_confirmed.website set to false.
No address, phone, or email in OSM record; location is a remote backcountry viewpoint with no street address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible viewpoint in the BC backcountry with confirmed mountain bike access and an outhouse, suitable for inclusion in a cycling tourism directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Site amenities listed on the trails page include: parking, benches, tables, view clearing, outhouse, fire ring, trail markers, and signage. MFLNRO was noted as considering installing a bailey bridge, suggesting some infrastructure improvements may have occurred since the 2016 listing.
